title: 17 January 1964: Live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
content:
This was the second date of The Beatles’ residency at the Olympia Theatre, on Paris’s Boulevard des Capucines.

Embed from Getty Images

The Beatles’ residency at the Olympia Theatre began on 16 January 1964 and ended on 4 February. They performed a set containing eight songs: ‘From Me To You’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘This Boy’, ‘Boys’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Twist And Shout’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 24 April 2026

  • 1973: Recording: Rode All Night by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: Recording: Junk, Singalong Junk by Paul McCartney
  • 1969: UK album release: Yellow Submarine
  • 1967: Recording, mixing: Penny Lane
  • 1967: John Lennon begins writing A Day In The Life
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Majestic Ballroom, Birkenhead
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1960: Stuart Sutcliffe sells a painting to John Moores
